statement: On a host that decides with policies (cosec.pipeline.mode=enforce), no adapter hands a handler a CoSec-Identity header a client sent: every permit of the pipeline strips it, and WebMvc, WebFlux and the gateway apply that alike. A service behind a gateway (mode gateway) keeps the header its gateway sent.
guards: spring-boot:WebAdapterParityTest#the three adapters hand on no client identity
runtime:IdentityForwardingTest#without an issuer a permit strips the client's identity and forwards none
